headline: Tabled ordinances to repeal bans on camping and on campers and recreational vehicles on public property.
summary: A request from John Flatley Company to buy city-owned parcels is listed under communications. A petition for Lot H-103 on L Deerwood Drive is also listed as tabled.
items: Communication from Owen Flynn, General Counsel, John Flatley Company, re request to purchase city-owned parcels
O-26-004: repeal ban on camping on public property
O-26-005: repeal ban on campers and recreational vehicles on public property
Petition for L Deerwood Drive, Lot H-103
